sampler: 8 corrective contexts:2 per admitted suffix;4 complete center contexts:1 per source segment;4 open,4 passage,2 drawer,2 stove episode/time-uniform
objective: One official real7 valid-time flow-matching BC loss; ordinary supervised replay for preservation
source_lineage: Original35 generated/simulation trajectories plus4 actual learned-teacher corrective suffixes; shared source families, not39 human demonstrations
diagnosis: Parent5k avoided added obstacles2/2 but reached goal1/2 at450 commands. Remaining repeat lost plate contact at359. Four qualified teacher recoveries provide actual commands from learner-visited late states.
research_scope: Learner-state corrective data plus supervised rehearsal. Inspired by DAgger; imperfect learned teacher and success-filtered fixed roll-ins are not the full DAgger algorithm.
gate: Center2/2 then nominal basic4/4,varied basic8/8,native retention6/6; root reviews before opening paired FINAL32 episodes
success_rule: Native goal OR50mm flat at stop and all10 holds;physical route and zero ever-added-wall contacts
